title: How to choose customer feedback software: 15 platforms and a shortlist framework
summary: The 15 best customer feedback software platforms compared, from survey tools to AI-moderated interviews, with pricing models and a shortlist by scenario.
body_markdown:
What’s the difference between customer feedback management and customer feedback analysis? +


Customer feedback management covers feedback collection and what happens next: sending feedback surveys, routing issues to the right team, and following up with customers. Customer feedback analysis works out what the feedback means by sorting raw feedback into themes and measuring customer sentiment. Most platforms do some of both, with real-time dashboards that show response rates and help teams identify trends as new survey data comes in.


Can AI accurately analyze open-text customer feedback? +


AI is accurate enough to sort large volumes of open-text feedback into themes and to label each comment’s sentiment as positive, negative, or neutral. Qualaroo, for example, offers AI sentiment analysis on survey responses. Accuracy drops with sarcasm, mixed opinions, and very short answers, so check a sample by hand. AI can only analyze what customers wrote, so getting detailed feedback on a vague comment means asking a follow-up question.


What does closing the feedback loop mean? +


Closing the feedback loop means making sure the right team acts on feedback and then telling the customer what happened. That might be a support agent replying to a low NPS score, or a product team tracking feature requests and letting users know when the one they asked for ships. When customers see their feedback lead to a change, they’re more likely to keep giving it, which builds customer loyalty and trust.


Do I need to replace my survey platform to understand why scores change? +


Not necessarily. Survey platforms are built to measure customer satisfaction at scale and show where a score moved, and they keep doing that job well. To find out why it moved, add a method that asks follow-up questions, such as interviews with customers from the customer segments where the score dropped. Many teams keep their survey software for tracking and run interviews when they need the reasons behind a change.


How do AI-moderated interviews differ from surveys? +


A survey asks everyone the same fixed questions, which makes it the best way to measure how many customers feel a certain way. An AI-moderated interview asks open questions on video, voice, or text and follows up when an answer is vague or incomplete, so you hear customer opinions in their own words. Teams usually run interviews with smaller groups and read them alongside their survey data.


How much does customer feedback software cost? +


Customer feedback software ranges from free plans to six-figure enterprise contracts. Survey tools often start at around $30 to $40 a month, and product feedback tools often charge per tracked user. Enterprise CX suites and AI-moderated research platforms are usually priced on request. Features like SSO and advanced reporting tend to sit on higher plans, so compare costs at the response volume you expect when choosing the right customer feedback tool.
